name: buffer.Buffer
summary: The `Buffer` class is a global type for dealing with binary data directly. It can be constructed in a variety of ways.
description:
Note that this `Buffer` class is highly related to the [Titanium.Buffer](api:Titanium.Buffer) type. Both are wrappers around an underlying array of bytes and can be accessed in an array-like manner:

``` javascript
const value = buffer[index];
buffer[index] = 1;
```

In fact, this Node.js shim has been written to allow wrapping a [Titanium.Buffer](api:Titanium.Buffer) into a Node.js compatible instance:

``` javascript
const wrapped = Buffer.from(tiBuffer);
```

Note that this will result in a **slow** `Buffer` instance (because reads/writes pass-through to the underlying
`Ti.Buffer` which in turn goes through the JS/native binding layer). If you only intend to *read* the data
(or do not need to write back to the original [Titanium.Buffer](api:Titanium.Buffer)) you can perform a one-time copy
of the underlying bytes to a faster JS-only `Uint8Array`:

```javascript
const fastBuffer = Buffer.from(tiBuffer.toBlob().toArrayBuffer()); // here we're converting from Blob to Ti.Buffer to ArrayBuffer and the shim wraps that copy
```

properties.name: buffer
properties.summary: The underlying `ArrayBuffer` object based on which this `Buffer` object is created.
properties.description: This `ArrayBuffer` is not guaranteed to correspond exactly to the original `Buffer`. See the notes on [buffer.Buffer.byteOffset](api:buffer.Buffer#byteOffset) for details.

properties.name: length
properties.summary: Returns the number of bytes in buf.

methods.name: compare
methods.summary: Compares `buf` with `target` and returns a number indicating whether buf comes before, after, or is the same as target in sort order. Comparison is based on the actual sequence of bytes in each `Buffer`.
methods.description:
`0` is returned if target is the same as buf
`1` is returned if target should come before buf when sorted.
`-1` is returned if target should come after buf when sorted.

parameters.name: target
parameters.summary: A `Buffer` or `Uint8Array` with which to compare buf.

parameters.name: targetStart
parameters.summary: The offset within target at which to begin comparison.

parameters.name: targetEnd
parameters.summary: The offset within target at which to end comparison (not inclusive).

parameters.name: sourceStart
parameters.summary: The offset within buf at which to begin comparison.

parameters.name: sourceEnd
parameters.summary: The offset within buf at which to end comparison (not inclusive).

methods.name: copy
methods.summary: Copies data from a region of `buf` to a region in `target`, even if the target memory region overlaps with `buf`.

parameters.name: target
parameters.summary: A `Buffer` or `Uint8Array` with which to compare buf.

parameters.name: targetStart
parameters.summary: The offset within target at which to begin writing.

parameters.name: sourceStart
parameters.summary: The offset within buf at which to begin copying.

parameters.name: sourceEnd
parameters.summary: The offset within buf at which to stop copying (not inclusive).

returns.summary: The number of bytes copied.

methods.name: entries
methods.summary: Creates and returns an [iterator](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Iteration_protocols#The_iterator_protocol) of `[index, byte]` pairs from the contents of `buf`.

methods.name: equals
methods.summary: Returns `true` if both `buf` and `otherBuffer` have exactly the same bytes, false otherwise. Equivalent to `buf.compare(otherBuffer) === 0`.

parameters.name: otherBuffer
parameters.summary: A `Buffer` or `Uint8Array` with which to compare buf.

methods.name: fill
methods.summary: Fills `buf` with the specified value. If the `offset` and `end` are not given, the entire `buf` will be filled.

parameters.name: value
parameters.summary: The value with which to fill `buf`.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.summary: Number of bytes to skip before starting to fill `buf`.

parameters.name: end
parameters.summary: Where to stop filling `buf` (not inclusive).

parameters.name: encoding
parameters.summary: The encoding for `value` if `value` is a string.

returns.summary: A reference to `buf`.

methods.name: includes
methods.summary: Equivalent to `buf.indexOf() !== -1`.

parameters.name: value
parameters.summary: What to search for.

parameters.name: byteOffset
parameters.summary: Where to begin searching in `buf`. If negative, then offset is calculated from the end of `buf`.

parameters.name: encoding
parameters.summary: If `value` is a string, this is its encoding.

returns.summary: `true` if `value` was found in buf, `false` otherwise.

methods.name: indexOf
methods.summary:
If value is:

- a string, `value` is interpreted according to the character encoding in `encoding`.
- a `Buffer` or `Uint8Array`, value will be used in its entirety. To compare a partial `Buffer`, use [buf.slice()](api:buffer.Buffer#slice).
- a number, `value` will be interpreted as an unsigned 8-bit integer value between `0` and `255`.

parameters.name: value
parameters.summary: What to search for.

parameters.name: byteOffset
parameters.summary: Where to begin searching in `buf`. If negative, then offset is calculated from the end of `buf`.

parameters.name: encoding
parameters.summary: If `value` is a string, this is the encoding used to determine the binary representation of the string that will be searched for in `buf`.

returns.summary: The index of the first occurrence of `value` in `buf`, or `-1` if `buf` does not contain `value`.

methods.name: keys
methods.summary: Creates and returns an [iterator](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Iteration_protocols#The_iterator_protocol) of `buf` keys (indices).

methods.name: lastIndexOf
methods.summary: Identical to `buf.indexOf()`, except the last occurrence of `value` is found rather than the first occurrence.

parameters.name: value
parameters.summary: What to search for.

parameters.name: byteOffset
parameters.summary: Where to begin searching in `buf`. If negative, then offset is calculated from the end of `buf`.

parameters.name: encoding
parameters.summary: If `value` is a string, this is the encoding used to determine the binary representation of the string that will be searched for in `buf`.

returns.summary: The index of the last occurrence of `value` in `buf`, or `-1` if `buf` does not contain `value`.

methods.name: readDoubleBE
methods.summary: Reads a 64-bit, big-endian double from `buf` at the specified `offset`.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.summary: Number of bytes to skip before starting to read. Must satisfy `0 <= offset <= buf.length - 8`.

methods.name: readDoubleLE
methods.summary: Reads a 64-bit, little-endian double from `buf` at the specified `offset`.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.summary: Number of bytes to skip before starting to read. Must satisfy `0 <= offset <= buf.length - 8`.

methods.name: readInt8
methods.summary:
Reads a signed 8-bit integer from `buf` at the specified `offset`.

Integers read from a Buffer are interpreted as two's complement signed values.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.summary: Number of bytes to skip before starting to read. Must satisfy `0 <= offset <= buf.length - 1`.

methods.name: readIntBE
methods.summary: Reads `byteLength` number of bytes from `buf` at the specified `offset` and interprets the result as a big-endian, two's complement signed value supporting up to 48 bits of accuracy.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.summary: Number of bytes to skip before starting to read. Must satisfy `0 <= offset <= buf.length - byteLength`.

parameters.name: byteLength
parameters.summary: Number of bytes to read. Must satisfy `0 < byteLength <= 6`.

parameters.name: byteLength
parameters.summary: Number of bytes to read. Must satisfy `0 < byteLength <= 6`.

methods.name: slice
methods.summary: Returns a new `Buffer` that references the same memory as the original, but offset and cropped by the `start` and `end` indices.

parameters.name: start
parameters.summary: here the new Buffer will start.

parameters.name: end
parameters.summary: Where the new Buffer will end (not inclusive).

methods.name: subarray
methods.summary: Returns a new `Buffer` that references the same memory as the original, but offset and cropped by the `start` and `end` indices.

parameters.name: start
parameters.summary: here the new Buffer will start.

parameters.name: end
parameters.summary: Where the new Buffer will end (not inclusive).

methods.name: swap16
methods.summary: Interprets `buf` as an array of unsigned 16-bit integers and swaps the byte order *in-place*.

methods.name: swap32
methods.summary: Interprets `buf` as an array of unsigned 32-bit integers and swaps the byte order *in-place*.

methods.name: swap64
methods.summary: Interprets `buf` as an array of unsigned 64-bit integers and swaps the byte order *in-place*.

methods.name: toJSON
methods.summary: Returns a JSON representation of `buf`. `JSON.stringify()` implicitly calls this function when stringifying a `Buffer` instance.

methods.name: toString
methods.summary: Decodes `buf` to a string according to the specified character encoding in `encoding`. `start` and `end` may be passed to decode only a subset of `buf`.

parameters.name: encoding
parameters.summary: The character encoding to use.

parameters.name: start
parameters.summary: The byte offset to start decoding at.

parameters.name: end
parameters.summary: The byte offset to stop decoding at (not inclusive).

methods.name: values
methods.summary: Creates and returns an [iterator](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Iteration_protocols#The_iterator_protocol) for `buf` values (bytes). This function is called automatically when a `Buffer` is used in a `for..of` statement.

methods.name: write
methods.summary: Writes `string` to `buf` at `offset` according to the character encoding in `encoding`. The `length` parameter is the number of bytes to write. If `buf` did not contain enough space to fit the entire string, only part of `string` will be written. However, partially encoded characters will not be written.

parameters.name: string
parameters.summary: String to write to `buf`.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.summary: Number of bytes to skip before starting to write string.

parameters.name: length
parameters.summary: Maximum number of bytes to write (written bytes will not exceed buf.length - offset).

parameters.name: encoding
parameters.summary: The character encoding of string.

returns.summary: Number of bytes written.

methods.name: writeDoubleBE
methods.summary: Writes `value` to `buf` at the specified `offset` as big-endian. The `value` must be a JavaScript number. Behavior is undefined when `value` is anything other than a JavaScript number.

parameters.name: value
parameters.summary: Number to be written to `buf`.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.summary: Number of bytes to skip before starting to write. Must satisfy `0 <= offset <= buf.length - 8`.

returns.summary: `offset` plus the number of bytes written.

methods.name: writeDoubleLE
methods.summary: Writes `value` to `buf` at the specified `offset` as little-endian. The `value` must be a JavaScript number. Behavior is undefined when `value` is anything other than a JavaScript number.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.summary: Number of bytes to skip before starting to write. Must satisfy `0 <= offset <= buf.length - 8`.

returns.summary: `offset` plus the number of bytes written.

parameters.name: offset

methods.name: writeInt16BE
methods.summary:
Writes `value` to `buf` at the specified `offset`. `value` must be a valid signed 16-bit integer. Behavior is undefined when `value` is anything other than a signed 16-bit integer.

`value` is interpreted and written as a two's complement signed integer.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.summary: Number of bytes to skip before starting to write. Must satisfy `0 <= offset <= buf.length - 2`.

returns.summary: `offset` plus the number of bytes written.
